dedupe_keys.name: large virtual antenna array based empirical channel characterization for sub thz indoor hall scenarios

description: Aalborg University researchers publish virtual-array channel measurements in a large hall and corridor. The May 2025 Zenodo release provides MATLAB frequency responses, deployment documentation and a README under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Nineteen responses belong to the first scenario and thirteen to the second. Measurements span 99–101 GHz, using omnidirectional 4.5-dBi antennas, ten-dBm transmit power and 1.3-metre antenna height. Receiver rotation uses one-degree increments on a 6.7-centimetre-radius virtual array; transmitter–receiver distances range from three to fifty-eight metres. Each response carries magnitude, phase and frequency. These measurements can calibrate sub-terahertz indoor propagation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. The separate deployment file is needed to map receiver labels to geometry. Observation dates, site identity and measurement uncertainty remain unknown, and two indoor scenarios do not establish general coverage statistics. No measurement arrays were opened.
